skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Conduct legal research and analysis on issues within the field of law and economics in organizations and businesses.
Identify and propose solutions to legal issues within organizations and businesses.
Demonstrate the ability to work independently and autonomously.
Analyze and synthesize information to solve complex legal problems.
Write comprehensive reports and theses on legal topics.
Effectively present research findings and solutions to legal issues.
Analyze legal frameworks and regulations within organizations and businesses.
Ensure compliance with legal requirements in organizational operations.
Understand and apply economic law principles in business contexts.
Apply knowledge of international trade law to business operations.
Analyze and apply business law principles to organizational issues.
Draft legal documents and agreements relevant to business operations.

prerequisite_courses: 75% of the total credits in the program
